settings.title: Carry Confidence
settings.lead: A boutique handbag house inspired by timeless luxury — warm palettes, sculptural lines, and pieces that elevate the everyday.
settings.image_alt: Girls Purse leather handbags on cream backdrop
settings.story: Girls Purse began with a simple belief: the right bag should make you feel pulled together before you leave the mirror. We curate totes, crossbodies, satchels, and clutches with boutique-level materials and honest craftsmanship.
settings.story_2: Every style is photographed to show grain, hardware, and interior organization clearly — so you know exactly how it will live in your closet. Whether you are commuting, traveling, or dressing for evening, we want your carry to feel effortless.
settings.quote: “Luxury you can live in — not just admire.”
